prompt_text:
Match this appearance phrase against ALL anonymous person tiles in the image(s): "the person with long dark hair, glasses, a black cropped top, black blazer, and black flared pants"
Every labeled tile is one different person from the same video; its two crops are held-out views. Labels and tile order do not reveal the intended target. A phrase may match none, one, or several people. Include ALL people who visibly satisfy the whole phrase in matches. Include in uncertain any plausible person for whom the views do not resolve an attribute, instead of assuming that person is a non-match. Do not pick a best match when several fit. A location or action does not distinguish appearance. Omitted labels mean clear non-matches.
Return {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"brief visual explanation"}. Valid labels: ["P01", "P02", "P03", "P04"].

message.content: {"matches":["P01"],"uncertain":[],"reason":"P01 clearly has long dark hair, glasses, a black cropped top, black blazer, and black flared pants in both crops. P02 has long dark hair and black blazer/pants but wears a white top with a tie, not a black cropped top. P03 has long dark hair and black outfit but no glasses and the top appears to be a long-sleeve shirt, not cropped. P04 has red hair, not dark, and wears a black top and blazer but the pants are slim, not flared. Only P01 fully matches all specified appearance attributes."}
